key_points: A comparative article questions whether Booking Holdings (BKNG) or Airbnb (ABNB) is a better stock to buy.
Multiple headlines report on various BKNG call and put options with different strikes and expirations (Apr 2027, Sep 2027, Oct 2026).
No new earnings, guidance, regulatory, M&A, or product news is presented.
The focus is on generic market commentary and options pricing rather than fundamental developments.
Overall, the headlines appear to be noise with little material impact on BKNG's thesis.
